verdict.rationale: Graphite's own docs describe an AI review agent that automatically reviews every PR, is codebase-aware, and is meant to catch bugs before they ship. Comment exclusions let teams suppress unwanted comments, which could cut down on nits. However, the evidence never says it detects logic errors, race conditions, or broken edge cases specifically, and nothing shows how accurate it is in practice. Missing for 10: documented detection of logic errors, race conditions, and edge cases; evidence of precision or signal-to-noise versus style nits; independent or hands-on corroboration of real bugs caught.

support.subject: As a developer, the reviewer catches real bugs in my PR — logic errors, race conditions, broken edge cases — not just style nits

citations.quote: automatically reviewing pull requests and catching bugs before they ship
no configuration required to start catching bugs in your pull requests
Get immediate, actionable feedback with Graphite’s codebase-aware AI code review agent.
Comment exclusions allow you to specify situations where Graphite Agent should not leave comments.
